analysis.overview: The frames overlap on administrative preparation but otherwise cover different practical domains. Shared guidance emphasizes checking changing deadlines, while context-specific distinctions preserve checklist detail and document-format requirements. The reference spans recurring household and personal routines; the compared frame concentrates on tax-receipt management.
